title: Exotic Juicy Middle Eastern Kidney Beans Fatteh
description: A nutty and juicy Middle Eastern dish featuring kidney beans, this fatteh is a crowd-pleaser and ovo-vegetarian friendly. It combines the flavors of ferment-jang with crunchy bread and fresh vegetables.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Toast the pita bread cubes until crispy and golden brown.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked kidney beans, ferment-jang, garlic, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the olive oil and a pinch of salt.
Add the toasted pita bread cubes to the bowl with the olive oil mixture and toss until the bread is evenly coated.
Add the bread mixture to the bowl with the kidney bean mixture and stir until well combined.
Top the fatteh with crumbled feta cheese and chopped parsley.
Garnish with additional parsley and lemon wedges if desired.
